ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, Subject, Description, FolderName, HtmlValue FROM EmailTemplate WHERE IsActive = true ORDER BY FolderName, Name
ApiNamedQuery.description: Lists every active email template the rep can use for a customer follow-up, with its folder/category and full HTML body, so Claude can present options grouped by kind of follow-up AND show the rep what will actually be sent before they confirm.
